column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/OrchestrationGoldenTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 1 automatic, 13 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:the golden binary owns extract_projections_mydata, compared per case since S3: golden.MydataGolden#ProjectionsArePartitioned proves that the 3 "<label>.extract_" keys (mydata.image, mydata.image.zero-key, mydata.glitch2, the file order) own every line exactly once, so the 3 rows of golden.Case/MydataProjection (PER_ROW) together are the old whole-file compare; the 3-case table and loop body move verbatim to extract_projections_mydata::render_case in tests/snapshots/MydataRender.cpp (emitted text unchanged), and extract_projections_mydata::render, the GX_GOLDEN whole-file renderer --update uses, concatenates render_case over the table; the glitch2 rebuild comes from the per-process variant cache (mydata::variant_build), so the Glitch2 row builds it itself and never relies on another test; the missing-rebuild, overload/shim and twice-identical check() messages are problems reported by ADD_FAILURE in the row case; the old summary line is retired (each row fails on its own and checks its own 12 agreements)

merged:OrchestrationGolden.main.AllSixDonorNoncesFilled;note:a missing or unreadable mydata/image.bin is the error of mydata::donor() ('mydata/image.bin reads: ...'), ASSERT_OK in golden.MydataGolden#ExtractAllFillsAllSixDonorNonces and in every Build/MydataBuild and Case/MydataProjection row, so it is a FAIL and never a skip
